title: Centre in the Square

services.name: Season Tickets
services.desc: Direct from New York! Enjoy the best of Broadway at Centre In The Square with Season Tickets. One Season Ticket package includes the same seat for all four Broadway performances, and saves you almost 25% compared to buying each show separately. Please note: Prices shown below are for the full 4-show Broadway Season Ticket package, not for one individual show. Your package includes one ticket to each of the four Broadway shows in the same seat. As an added bonus, Broadway in Kitchener passholders get to purchase tickets for The Book of Mormon before the general public. Centre In The Square is operated by a not-for-profit registered charity. Charitable Corporation Number: 11922 1703
